PawSharp.Voice

Represents a voice connection to a Discord voice channel.

sections.title: PawSharp.Voice.DAVE
sections.content:
PawSharp.Voice.DAVE

MLS (Message Layer Security, RFC 9420) group state for DAVE. Implements the full RFC 9420 protocol for the DAVE ciphersuite: MLS_128_DHKEMX25519_AES128GCM_SHA256_Ed25519 This class is the public face of the MLS implementation. All heavy lifting is delegated to (the internal RFC 9420 engine). Per-SSRC AES-128 sender keys are derived from the epoch secret on first access and cached for the lifetime of the epoch. The cache is invalidated on every epoch advance (ProcessCommit / ProcessWelcome).

Methods

EncryptFrame(Byte[] plaintext, Byte[] key, uint ssrc, ulong frameCounter, Byte[] additionalData)

Encrypts a voice frame with AES-128-GCM.

ParameterDescription

Returns: Decrypted plaintext (Opus data).

sections.title: PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.Crypto
sections.content:
PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.Crypto

MLS RFC 9420 §7.4 — HKDF label functions. All MLS-specific HKDF derivations prepend the string "MLS 1.0 " to the label before calling HKDF-Expand, ensuring domain separation from other protocols. The DAVE ciphersuite uses SHA-256 throughout (hash output length = 32 bytes).

sections.content:
PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.Crypto.Curve25519

Methods

GenerateKeyPair(Byte[]@ privateKey, Byte[]@ publicKey)

Generates a random X25519 key pair (private scalar, public point).

ParameterDescription
privateKey32-byte private key (clamped).
publicKey32-byte public key (scalar-mult of base point).

SharedSecret(ReadOnlySpan<Byte> privateKey, ReadOnlySpan<Byte> publicKey)

Computes the X25519 shared secret: ECDH(myPrivate, theirPublic).

ParameterDescription
privateKey32-byte clamped private scalar.
publicKey32-byte peer public key (u-coordinate).

Returns: 32-byte shared secret u-coordinate.

ScalarMult()

Raw X25519 scalar multiplication: u * k (both 32 bytes, little-endian).

ClampScalar()

Clamps a private scalar in-place per RFC 7748 §5.

FReduce()

Propagate carries to keep limbs in ~51-bit range.

FPow22523()

Computes a^(2^252-3) mod p using a pre-computed addition chain, which gives a^(-1) when followed by FMul(a, result). RFC 7748 uses a^(p-2) = a^(2^255-21). This is: a^(2^252 + 27742317777372353535851937790883648493 - 3) We compute a^(p-2) directly using the standard Curve25519 chain.

FPowChain()

Square k times: a^(2^k).

Load51()

Loads 32 little-endian bytes into 5×51-bit limbs.

Save51()

Serialises 5×51-bit limbs to 32 little-endian bytes.

Properties

Standard base point u = 9 in little-endian encoding.

sections.content:
PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.Crypto.MlsHkdf

Methods

Extract(ReadOnlySpan<Byte> salt, ReadOnlySpan<Byte> ikm)

HKDF-Extract(salt, IKM) → PRK using SHA-256. RFC 5869 §2.2

ParameterDescription
saltSalt (may be zero-length, treated as HashLen zero bytes per RFC 5869).
ikmInput keying material.

Returns: 32-byte pseudo-random key.

Expand()

HKDF-Expand(PRK, info, length) → OKM using SHA-256. RFC 5869 §2.3

ExpandWithLabel(ReadOnlySpan<Byte> secret, string label, ReadOnlySpan<Byte> context, int length)

ExpandWithLabel(Secret, Label, Context, Length) → bytes RFC 9420 §7.4: ExpandWithLabel(Secret, Label, Context, Length) = HKDF-Expand(Secret, KDFLabel, Length) struct { uint16 length; opaque label<7..255>; // "MLS 1.0 " + Label opaque context<0..2^32-1>; } KDFLabel;

ParameterDescription
secretThe base secret (PRK).
labelLabel string (without the "MLS 1.0 " prefix).
contextContext bytes (can be empty).
lengthOutput length in bytes.

DeriveSecret()

DeriveSecret(Secret, Label) → bytes of length HashLen. RFC 9420 §7.4: DeriveSecret(Secret, Label) = ExpandWithLabel(Secret, Label, "", HashLen)

ExpandWithLabelN()

Derives a secret of a specific length from a labeled context. Used when the length differs from HashLen (e.g., AES key material).

Hash()

SHA-256 hash of arbitrary data. Used for transcript hashes.

BuildKdfLabel()

Encodes the KDFLabel structure per RFC 9420 §7.4 (TLS presentation language). struct { uint16 length; opaque label<7..255>; // 1-byte length-prefix + label bytes opaque context<0..2^32-1>; // 4-byte length-prefix + context bytes } KDFLabel;

sections.title: PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.State
sections.content:
PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.State

RFC 9420 §8 — MLS Key Schedule. Derives the per-epoch secrets from the commit secret (TreeKEM output) and the current GroupContext. Derivation chain (simplified for the DAVE ciphersuite): init_secret(n-1) → ┐ commit_secret → ├→ Extract → joiner_secret ↓ joiner_secret → DeriveSecret("welcome") → welcome_secret welcome_secret → DeriveSecret("epoch") → not used directly joiner_secret + GroupContext → Extract → epoch_secret epoch_secret → DeriveSecret("exporter") → exporter_secret epoch_secret → DeriveSecret("confirmed") → confirmation_key epoch_secret → DeriveSecret("sender data") → sender_data_secret exporter_secret → used by DAVE to derive the 32-byte epoch secret passed to References: RFC 9420 §8 — https://www.rfc-editor.org/rfc/rfc9420#section-8

identityCaller identity bytes (Discord user ID as UTF-8).

ProcessWelcome()

Processes an MLS Welcome message (opcode 25) per RFC 9420 §12.4.3.1. Full path: 1. Decode the TLS-encoded WelcomeMessage. 2. Decrypt our EncryptedGroupSecrets entry via HPKE-Base using the local init key. 3. Derive welcome_key + welcome_nonce from the welcome_secret and use them to AES-128-GCM decrypt the GroupInfo. 4. Populate group state (epoch, tree hash, transcript hash) from GroupInfo.Context. 5. Run and store the key schedule for subsequent epoch advances. 6. Derive the DAVE epoch secret via ExpandWithLabel("DAVE sender"). Falls back to a domain-separated HKDF shortcut if the full parse fails (e.g. a non-standard Discord framing edge case), so the session still produces a usable epoch secret.

TryDecryptAndDecodeGroupInfo()

Decrypts and decodes the GroupInfo that Discord ships inside Welcome.EncryptedGroupInfo. RFC 9420 §12.4.3.1: the encrypted payload is ciphertext || 16-byte-GCM-tag (no prepended nonce — the nonce is derived from the key schedule).

ProcessProposals()

Queues incoming MLS Proposals (opcode 27) for application at the next Commit. Proposals are parsed from the wire-format bytes and stored in memory. They do not change the epoch until processed by .

ProcessCommit()

Processes an MLS Commit (opcode 26) and advances the epoch per RFC 9420 §12.4. Full path: 1. Decode the Commit (proposals + optional UpdatePath). 2. Apply queued proposals (Add/Remove/Update) and any inline commit proposals. 3. Merge the UpdatePath into the ratchet tree to obtain the commit secret. 4. Update the transcript hash and tree hash. 5. Advance the RFC 9420 key schedule and re-derive the DAVE epoch secret. Falls back to HKDF rotation if decode fails, preserving forward secrecy.

Reset()

Resets all group state so the instance can be reused for a new session (e.g. after a voice channel reconnect without re-creating the protocol object). Wipes all key material before clearing.

Properties

IsInitialized

True once a Welcome or Commit has successfully established epoch secrets.

EpochNumber

The current MLS epoch number.

DaveEpochSecret

The current DAVE epoch secret (32 bytes); null until .

GroupId

The MLS group identifier.

sections.content:
PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.State.MLSKeySchedule

Constructors

MLSKeySchedule(Byte[] commitSecret, Byte[] groupContextBytes)

Initialises the key schedule for the very first epoch (epoch 0). Used when creating a new group.

ParameterDescription
commitSecretThe initial commit secret (32 zero bytes for the first epoch, per RFC 9420 §8).
groupContextBytesSerialised GroupContext for epoch 0.

Methods

FromJoinerSecret(Byte[] joinerSecret, Byte[] groupContextBytes)

Constructs a key schedule from a joiner_secret received in a Welcome. RFC 9420 §8.2 — joiner path.

ParameterDescription
joinerSecretDecrypted from Welcome's GroupSecrets.
groupContextBytesThe GroupContext from the GroupInfo in the Welcome.

AdvanceEpoch(Byte[] newCommitSecret, Byte[] newGroupContextBytes)

Advances the key schedule by one epoch using the new commit secret. Must be called after every successful Commit.

ParameterDescription
newCommitSecretTreeKEM path secret at the root for this Commit.
newGroupContextBytesGroupContext for the new epoch.

Advance()

Core key schedule derivation. joiner_secret = HKDF-Extract(init_secret, commit_secret) welcome_secret = DeriveSecret(joiner_secret, "welcome") epoch_secret = HKDF-Extract(DeriveSecret(joiner_secret, "epoch"), groupContext) exporter_secret = DeriveSecret(epoch_secret, "exporter") confirmation_key = DeriveSecret(epoch_secret, "confirmed") new_init_secret = DeriveSecret(epoch_secret, "init")

DeriveDaveEpochSecret()

Derives the 32-byte DAVE epoch secret from using MLS-Export with the DAVE-specific label. RFC 9420 §8.5 — MLS-Exporter: exporter_value = DeriveSecret( ExpandWithLabel(exporter_secret, label, context, HashLen), "exporter")

Properties

InitSecret

The init secret carried forward to the next epoch.

JoinerSecret

32-byte joiner secret (used to produce welcome_secret for new members).

EpochSecret

32-byte epoch secret (root of all per-epoch key derivations).

ExporterSecret

32-byte exporter secret — exposed to DAVE as the top-level epoch secret.

ConfirmationKey

32-byte confirmation key — HMAC key for the confirmation tag.

WelcomeSecret

32-byte welcome secret — used to encrypt GroupInfo for new members.

sections.title: PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.Tree
sections.content:
PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.Tree

A node in the MLS ratchet tree (RFC 9420 §7). Each node holds: - An HPKE public key (and optionally the corresponding private key for leaf nodes owned by this client). - For leaf nodes: the member's (identity material). - A blank flag: blank nodes have no key material and represent absent tree positions. The tree uses projective x-only coordinates (Curve25519). Key sizes are Curve25519: 32 bytes.

Constructors

Methods

Adds a new leaf at the next available position with the given HPKE key and credential. Returns the leaf node index (even).

Replaces the HPKE public key on a leaf node (Update proposal, RFC 9420 §12.1.2).

Finds the in-order node index of the first leaf whose credential bytes match . Returns null when not found.

Blanks the direct path from a leaf up to (but not including) the root. Used when removing a member (RFC 9420 §12.4 step 2).

MergeUpdatePath(uint senderLeafIndex, IReadOnlyList<UpdatePathNode> updatePath, ReadOnlySpan<Byte> groupContext)

Applies a Commit's UpdatePath to the tree, deriving the new commit secret from the path secret decryptable by the local leaf. RFC 9420 §12.4 step 4.

ParameterDescription
senderLeafIndexLeaf index (NOT node index) of the committer.
updatePathSequence of (HPKE public key, encrypted path secrets) for each level on the sender's direct path. Each entry's encrypted list is indexed by the copath resolution nodes.
groupContextThe GroupContext bytes used as AAD for HPKE.

Returns: The commit secret (path secret at root level) if the local key can decrypt it; otherwise the path secret is from an unrelated subtree and the caller must have received it via Welcome.

TreeHash()

Computes the RFC 9420 §7.8 tree hash for the full tree.

Properties

LeafCount

Number of leaves currently in the tree.

LocalLeafIndex

The (even) node index of the local client's leaf, or null if not set.

Fields

_nodes

All nodes, indexed by in-order index (0 = first leaf, 1 = root of 2-leaf tree, …).

_blank

Set of blank node indices (for resolution queries).

sections.title: PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.Tree.TreeMath
sections.content:
PawSharp.Voice.DAVE.MLS.Tree.TreeMath

Methods

IsLeaf()

True when is a leaf node (even index).

Level()

The level of node in the tree. Leaves are at level 0. Level increases by 1 for each parent step. Defined as: the number of trailing 1-bits in x.

NodeWidth()

The total number of nodes in a tree with leaves. Formula: 2n - 1

Root()

The index of the root node for a tree of leaves.

Left()

Returns the left child of node . Requires to be an internal (non-leaf) node.

Right()

Returns the right child of node . Requires to be an internal (non-leaf) node.

Parent()

Returns the parent of node in a tree of leaves.

Sibling()

Returns the sibling of node in a tree of leaves.

DirectPath()

The direct path of a leaf node: the sequence of ancestor nodes from the leaf's parent up to (but not including) the root. RFC 9420 §7.1

CoPath()

The copath of a leaf node: for each node on the direct path, its sibling (the node that must be hashed to verify the tree). The copath has the same length as the direct path.

LeafToNode()

Converts leaf index to its node index (2*l).

NodeToLeaf()

Converts node index to leaf index (x/2). Requires even x.

Resolution()

Returns the resolution of node in a tree of leaves: the set of non-blank descendants that cover the subtree. The blank list enumerates known-blank node indices.

Methods

GenerateKeyPackage(Byte[] identity)

Generates (or reuses) a TLS-encoded KeyPackage for the local client. The associated private key material (init key, HPKE leaf key, signing key) is stored inside the group state so that a subsequent call can decrypt the EncryptedGroupSecrets entry addressed to us.

ParameterDescription
identityThe caller's Discord user ID encoded as UTF-8 bytes.

Returns: TLS-encoded KeyPackage bytes, suitable for sending as op 21.

ProcessWelcome(Byte[] welcome, Byte[] groupId)

Processes an MLS Welcome message (opcode 25). Decrypts the GroupSecrets using the local init key, derives the epoch secret via the RFC 9420 key schedule, and transitions the group to epoch 1.

ParameterDescription
welcomeRaw TLS-encoded MLS Welcome bytes.
groupIdOptional group ID for validation (may be null).

ProcessCommit(Byte[] commit)

Processes an MLS Commit (opcode 26). Applies pending proposals and the UpdatePath to the ratchet tree, then advances the key schedule to derive the new epoch secret.

ParameterDescription
commitRaw TLS-encoded MLS Commit bytes.

ProcessProposals(Byte[] proposals)

Queues one or more MLS Proposals (opcode 27) for application at the next Commit. Proposals (Add / Remove / Update) are parsed and cached internally. They do not affect the epoch secret until a Commit is processed.

ParameterDescription
proposalsTLS-encoded MLS Proposal bytes (may be concatenated).

GetSenderKey(uint ssrc)

Returns the 16-byte AES-128 sender key for the given SSRC in the current epoch. Keys are derived on first access and cached for the lifetime of the epoch.

ParameterDescription
ssrcThe sender's SSRC.

Reset()

Resets the MLS group state for reconnection, wiping all key material. After this call the group must be re-entered via .

Current MLS epoch number.

EpochSecret

Current 32-byte epoch secret (the DAVE-specific MLS exporter secret). Null until the group has been established via .

MLS group identifier.

True when the MLS group has been established and the DAVE protocol is active.

Stops the current audio playback, if any.

Stops the current audio playback. Alias for with an async signature for use in async pipelines.

PlayAsync(string filePath, CancellationToken cancellationToken)

Reads an audio file, resamples it to 48 kHz mono PCM if necessary, encodes it with Opus, and streams it to the voice channel. Raises the Discord Speaking gate automatically.

ParameterDescription
filePathPath to an audio file readable by NAudio (WAV, MP3, AIFF, etc.).
cancellationTokenToken to cancel mid-stream playback.

PlayAsync(WaveStream pcmStream, CancellationToken cancellationToken)

Reads 16-bit signed mono PCM at 48 kHz from and streams it to the voice channel. Use when you have a file in another format — it handles resampling automatically.

ParameterDescription
pcmStreamA whose format is (or will be resampled to) 48 kHz, mono, 16-bit PCM. If the format does not match the Opus requirements it is automatically resampled via .
cancellationTokenToken to cancel mid-stream playback.

StartCapture()

Starts capturing audio from the microphone and raises the Discord Speaking gate (op 5).

StopCapture()

Stops capturing audio from the microphone and lowers the Discord Speaking gate (op 5).

PlayAudioAsync(Byte[] audioData)

Plays audio data.

ParameterDescription

Returns: A task representing the asynchronous operation.

PlayAudioFromPcmAsync(Byte[] pcmData)

Plays already-decoded 16-bit signed mono PCM data at 48 kHz through the local speaker. Called internally by the receive loop after Opus decoding; also available for external use.

ParameterDescription
pcmDataRaw PCM bytes (16-bit signed LE, mono, 48 kHz).

SendAudioAsync(Byte[] audioData)

Encodes and sends PCM audio to the voice channel. Input must be 16-bit signed mono PCM at 48 kHz (matching the capture ). Internally the method accumulates samples across calls until a complete 20 ms Opus frame ( bytes) is available, then encodes, wraps in an RTP header, applies DAVE AES-128-GCM encryption, and transmits the packet.

ParameterDescription
audioDataRaw 16-bit signed PCM bytes to transmit.

EncodeFrame()

Opus-encodes exactly one 20 ms PCM frame ( bytes of 16-bit samples). Returns when the encoder is unavailable or encoding fails.

DecodeAudio()

Decodes an Opus-encoded packet to 16-bit mono PCM at 48 kHz. Returns the input unchanged when the decoder is unavailable.

SetSpeakingAsync(bool speaking)

Sends the Discord Speaking (op 5) payload to gate audio transmission. Raises or lowers the speaking indicator so that Discord shows the microphone animation and correctly routes the voice stream. Call with before sending the first audio frame and with after the stream ends.

ParameterDescription
speakingto raise; to lower.

BuildRtpHeader()

Builds a 12-byte RTP fixed header (RFC 3550 §5.1) for the next outgoing audio packet. Sequence number (uint16) and timestamp (uint32, 48 kHz clock) advance on every call.

TryParseRtpPacket()

Parses the fixed 12-byte RTP header from an inbound voice packet. Returns the sender SSRC (used for DAVE per-sender key derivation), the raw header bytes (passed as DAVE AAD), and the encrypted payload.

Returns: when the packet contains a valid 12-byte header.

Raised whenever a decoded PCM audio frame is received from another speaker. The first argument is the sender SSRC and the second is the raw 16-bit signed mono PCM byte array at 48 kHz — identical to what is fed to the local speaker. Subscribe to this event to capture or process incoming voice audio (e.g. speech-to-text transcription) without relying on NAudio playback.
